review_method: Read each linked page, compared its concepts with existing notes and the revised local AQA specification. Retained existing worked examples, tables and diagrams. Additions use original wording and examples.

coverage_decisions.decision: Existing required threats and controls retained. Added an original permissions-test lifecycle and focused cards on limits, supported software, reuse, media and recovery. Did not import fixed password-cracking times or the source quiz’s false claim that penetration testing does not find flaws.

Added targeted-phishing and independent-contact clarification plus HTTPS limits. Did not import a padlock as proof against fraud, a broad-only definition of phishing, or adware as a named revised requirement. Preserved the required virus/trojan/spyware distinction.

checks.browser_review: Passed all topic reading groups and expanded deck at 1366, 390 and 320 pixels. Checked print visibility, hidden sources, focus, keyboard controls, long prose and code answers.
